selection_unit: each real image block independently, including global thumbnail; no CLS
score: native eager attention, float32 mean of heads and valid queries, one score per key; invalid keys excluded
tie: descending score, then ascending original grid index; selection restored to ascending original index
mask: valid keys masked in fresh native additive 4D mask; valid queries only in scoring
physical_padding: each block effective K; pad batch to K_max; padded slots masked, never scatter; report actual lengths
mapping: compose selection indices with current original-position map at every stage
insertion: after native attention residual, before norm2 + current VisionMLP; gather residual as well
adapter: retained features traverse all remaining Encoder layers and original vision.post_layernorm, then scatter into zero original grid before unchanged Connector
rate_1: explicit bypass of extra scoring, selection, padding and scatter; native behavior including original padding
